messages.subject: For Abdulsalam Al Murshidi | Sovereign investment, economic diplomacy and strategic partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Oman Investment Authority Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before H.E. Abdulsalam bin Mohammed Al Murshidi, President.

OIA's mandate across strategic sectors and international investment partnerships sits at the intersection of government priorities, economic development and long-term capital. That interface aligns closely with my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate execution across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and emerging-market execution might support OIA's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Oman Investment Authority.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
